navaid.name: Larius
navaid.description: Larius is one of two shipwrecks at Skipstadsand; it is visible only during low tide, when it barely protrudes above the water, and is believed to have been deliberately sunk.

navaid.name: Olga
navaid.description: Olga is one of two shipwrecks at Skipstadsand, it is visible at both high and low tide, with its bow and stern protruding above the water.
